headline: Singavarapu Chandrasekhar files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Singavarapu Chandrasekhar has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, signalling a substantial share acquisition in Bhagiradha Chemicals & Industries Limited. The filing marks entry into the mandatory disclosure regime for acquisitions crossing the 5% threshold.
detail: Singavarapu Chandrasekhar has submitted the prescribed disclosure form to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is mandatory within two trading days of crossing the 5% threshold in listed equity. The filing does not specify acquisition value, mode (open market, block trade, preferential allotment) or ultimate intent (control, passive investment, or delisting), which are typically revealed in the detailed PAC/acquirer statement.
